description: How the first-contact harvest classes Wikidata statements (25-LIVES-AND-PLAYGROUND.md section 10). Defaults go by datatype: external-id is an identifier; wikibase-item is a relationship (mapped to a predicate through the predicate registry's wikidata mappings, otherwise unmapped and kept); time is a dated claim; other literals are attributes. The lists below override the defaults. Every PID here was checked against Wikidata's own label when the harvest report resolves it.

notes.P1343: described by source stays a relationship (registry: describedBy), Wikidata's own bibliography of the entity: input for the Subject 'Read more' list (25 section 8)
notes.P1038: relative stays an unmapped relationship until its kinship qualifier (P1039) is mapped; legacy code lost that qualifier
